questions.question: What law did the officials trick Darius into making to trap Daniel?
options: That no one at all could leave the high walls of the city after dark
That no one could do any work at all on the special day set apart for the king
That no one could pray to any god or man except the king for thirty days
That no one could eat any meat or drink any wine for a full month
questions.answer: That no one could pray to any god or man except the king for thirty days

questions.question: What happened when Daniel was thrown into the lions' den?
options: God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths
A great storm scattered the beasts in fear
The lions had already been fed and slept
The king's soldiers drove the lions away
questions.answer: God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths
